newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds closed a bit higher in the same lifeless trade of recent days while a stronger peseta added few incentives, dealers said.
"The peseta climbed higher versus the mark," a dealer in Madrid said "but the only effect on our market was a slight flattening in the yield curve".
He added the long bond future was likely to remain glued to the tight trading range within which it has moved in recent days, at least before the end of this week.
Earlier the Treasury's six-month bills showed a modest increase in yields, with no effect on the market, dealers said.
